title: telinaria lobelii
intro: Telinaria lobelii, commonly known as Telin, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, native to New Caledonia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, antioxidant properties, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Telinaria lobelii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
